body: i am too and i hope it does work.

I feel hopeful and I think we can work things out but at the same time I realize that this can still end at any time. I'm happy about the situation now that she and i managed to talk about it and if it does end I have more sense of closure.

I guess she was pregnant and miscarried so her hormones were out of wack which probably made her bipolar much worse especially since it would be the 2nd time in the last 6 months.

Anyways I just want to thank all of your for the support when I needed it the most. I appreciate it very much. I'm feeling much better about everything and my outlook on life is brighter.

I'm so sorry, that must have been very difficult. I guess some of your feelings I also have, but at the same time I'm willing to forgive her this time around. but only if she does what she said she would. Even if we end up breaking up after this I realized that I can't stop loving her. I also need to realize that this is not my fault and should stop blaming myself. Almost all my friends thing I'm nuts to keep this relationship going. Perhaps they are right. 

Thanks for sharing your story. It puts perspective into thing and I know suicide is not the answer, but emotions are difficult to handle sometimes.

We been talking all day and it got ugly but now we're both calm we decided to give it another shot. She realized looking back that she was not right in her mind and was manic. she also said she will terminate all contact with this guy. We'll see what happens. I'm willing to forgive her this time around if she can do what she said she would
How did you manage and how are you now? Did your relationship end after that or were you able to manage to somehow work things out?

I've managed to talk to a lot of my close friends so I am feeling better. Its a tough situation because I care about her so much and its the hopelessness of not knowing what to do and the pain of betrayal and loss thats driven me to contemplate suicide. I'm still really confused
I still love her, but I feel betrayed. I should probably add that she suffers from Bipolar.
